name: Hunyuan3D 2.0 (Image → 3D + PBR Textures)
description: Tencent's state-of-the-art image-to-3D model (2024). Generates high-fidelity meshes with full PBR texture maps (albedo, roughness, normal). Best quality available locally — rivals cloud tools like Meshy.
author: Tencent (extension by Dodai)

params_schema.label: Diffusion steps
params_schema.tooltip: More steps = better quality but slower. 50 is a good balance.

params_schema.label: Guidance scale
params_schema.tooltip: How strictly the model follows the input image.

params_schema.label: PBR Textures
params_schema.tooltip: Generate full PBR textures (albedo, roughness, normal). Requires ~4 GB extra VRAM. Disable on low VRAM GPUs.

params_schema.label: Auto remove background
params_schema.tooltip: Automatically remove the image background before processing. Strongly recommended for best results.
